releaseNotes:
CantosTV 1.5.62

Parental locks
- Anything you lock now stays hidden everywhere, not just on the screen you
  locked it from. This closes gaps in Multiscreen, the player's Channels and
  Episodes lists, the Home rails, the TV Guide, Favourites and Downloads.
- Locking something now also stops it if it is already playing, and takes
  effect on a screen you are already looking at, including when the lock was
  set on another device.
